headline: MIL @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 4.56 at ATL 3.46, with a projected total of 8.02. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: MIL moved -0.20 runs while ATL moved -0.44, changing the projected margin by +0.23 runs. The projected total fell -0.73, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Jacob Misiorowski has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, Michael Harris II, Christian Yelich, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Mateo, Mike Yastrzemski because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
